name: arzwp Product Tabs for WooCommerce
author: ARZWP

sections.description:
arzwp Product Tabs for WooCommerce lets you add exactly the information your customers need to the product page, in tabs you control.

Features:

  • Tabs with custom text and images (full WordPress editor)
  • Image gallery tabs with a configurable column count
  • Video gallery tabs (YouTube, Vimeo, self-hosted MP4/WebM)
  • FAQ tabs with an accessible accordion
  • Contact form tabs with AJAX submission, honeypot spam protection and optional copy to the customer
  • Downloadable files tabs with file type, size and download buttons
  • Map tabs powered by the Google Maps Embed API (with a keyless fallback)
  • Custom text above the content of every tab
  • Shortcodes supported inside every tab
  • Global tabs shown on all products
  • Category tabs shown only on products in selected categories (sub-categories included)
  • Hide any global tab on individual products
  • Drag-and-drop tab ordering
  • Built-in icon picker plus custom icon uploads
  • Disable WooCommerce default tabs globally or per product
  • Override the content of a WooCommerce default tab on a single product
  • Hide tabs on mobile devices (configurable breakpoint) or on desktop
  • Colour and icon-position controls for FAQ tabs
  • Colour controls for contact form tabs
  • Colour controls for downloadable files tabs
  • A shortcode to render any tab anywhere on the page

Support the plugin

This plugin is free. If it saves you time, you can support its development with a donation: https://payhip.com/b/Ot45S

External services

The Map tab embeds Google Maps through an iframe. When a visitor opens a product page that contains a Map tab, the visitor’s browser connects to Google (google.com/maps) and Google may receive the visitor’s IP address and the address configured in the tab. If you add a Google Maps Embed API key in the plugin settings, that key is sent to Google as part of the request.

  • Service: Google Maps Embed
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Video tabs can embed YouTube or Vimeo videos using WordPress’s built-in oEmbed support. Those providers receive the visitor’s IP address when the video is displayed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the arzwp-product-tabs-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Products > Product Tabs to create global tabs, or open any product and use the Custom Tabs panel in the Product data box.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Maps API key?

No. Without a key the plugin uses a keyless Google Maps embed. Adding an Embed API key under Products > Product Tabs > Settings gives more reliable results.

Where do contact form messages go?

To the default recipient set on the Settings screen, unless the individual tab defines its own recipient.
